system_prompt: You are a careful and skilled AI assistant. Provide your best answer to the following prompt. Keep your response under 500 words.
response: Empirical science is a candle, not a sun. Every measurement is finite, every instrument noisy, every theory underdetermined by the data it must serve. Yet a candle, faithfully tended, reliably illuminates whatever room you carry it through. We will never see the universe in absolute clarity, because the universe is larger than any single flame; but we will see, step by step, far further than any other tool has carried us. Certainty is a comfort. Calibration is a method. Science gives up the first to earn the second, and that quiet exchange is why, in the long dark, science wins.
